discription: A warm saw wave pad with a simple low-pass filter and an extended ADSR envelope.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, cutoff=2000, rq=0.5, pan=0.0; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.5, 0.5, 0.7, 3.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = LPF.ar(sig, cutoff, rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan)); }
